highlights: Shaving a second off a real-time speech-to-LLM pipeline in Electron

items.title: Shaving a second off a real-time speech-to-LLM pipeline in Electron
items.summary_en: Reducing a real-time speech-to-LLM pipeline from 3.2s to ~1.5s to first token on screen, the author implemented client-side VAD (AudioWorklet, raw-signal detection, 0.005 RMS threshold, 1.0s hangover, 600ms preroll), used ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime's `commit_strategy: 'vad'` for server-side endpointing, added a generation counter to prevent stale socket interleaving, and removed the 200ms "question classifier" that was misidentifying follow-up statements.

items.title: lightningpixel/modly
items.summary_en: Modly is a free, open-source desktop application by Lightning Pixel that generates 3D mesh models from images using local AI models running entirely on your GPU. It supports Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS, with extensible model options including Hunyuan3D 2 Mini, TripoSG, and Trellis2 GGUF through its extension system. The app also includes a CLI for scripted automation and in-app mesh smoothing and decimation.

items.title: infiniflow/ragflow
items.summary_en: RAGFlow is an open-source RAG engine that combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Agent capabilities, supporting LLMs including DeepSeek v4, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5 series. It features deep document understanding with template-based chunking, grounded citations to reduce hallucinations, and compatibility with heterogeneous data sources like Word, Excel, images, and web pages. The platform supports self-hosting via Docker with minimum requirements of 4 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM, and 50 GB disk, and offers multi-channel chat integration through Feishu, Discord, Telegram, and Line.

items.title: Show HN: Kvcachescope – Why Nvidia-smi is blind to vLLM KV cache leaks
items.summary_en: kvcachescope is a logical memory profiler and state inspector for PagedAttention inference engines like vLLM and SGLang, providing real-time visibility into KV cache leaks invisible to standard profilers like nvidia-smi. It hooks directly into the BlockSpaceManager at 10Hz to visualize virtual token-to-physical block mapping, flag state divergence, and detect unreleased blocks, including a reclaim endpoint for restoring free queues without restarting model pods. The tool also supports CI integration with configurable zero-zombie tolerance assertions and performance benchmarking for internal slack waste evaluation.

items.title: Show HN: Macsomnia – close your MacBook lid while keeping long jobs alive
items.summary_en: Macsomnia is a macOS menu-bar app (requires macOS 13+) that prevents sleep in clamshell mode using a privileged daemon running `pmset -b disablesleep 1` as root. It provides a red strip and live countdown across all displays, offers auto-off timers (30 min to 8 hours), and is intended only for light workloads due to heat risks with the lid closed. Available via Homebrew (`brew install --cask macsomnia`) or direct download, under an MIT license.

items.title: Writing evidence-linked docs exposed two missing regression tests
items.summary_en: Building documentation for the open-source CLI tool agent-cost with evidence-linked claims via the evidence-docs tool exposed two missing regression tests (GAP-01 and GAP-02) — one in cache-write TTL breakdown logic and another in pricing-status aggregation ordering. Neither was a live bug, but both covered edge cases where existing tests only handled extremes, leaving the middle scenarios unasserted and vulnerable to silent breakage during refactors. Both gaps were resolved through small PRs adding regression tests with zero implementation changes.

items.title: We got so sick of users typing 1-word queries that i built a search bar that refuses to let you hit enter until you make sense
items.summary_en: A developer created an AI-powered search bar that blocks vague, one-word queries like "bug" or "shirt" by routing inputs through an AI-autocomplete intent layer before submission. The system dynamically parses user keystrokes to capture parameters and structures them into a JSON payload, eliminating the need for approximately 500 lines of custom frontend filtering code. The solution was shared by Reddit user /u/OnlyBath9046.

items.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
items.summary_en: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run on their own hardware, contrasting with its more powerful Muse Spark model locked behind its own APIs. The release accompanied Mark Zuckerberg's 6,500-word manifesto arguing AI should be "for everyone" rather than controlled by a handful of labs — though podcast hosts noted significant asterisks on that vision. The episode also covered the AI industry's energy costs and a $250M acquisition that failed.

items.title: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing update
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has launched the DeepSeek-V4-Pro general availability release, featuring enhanced agent capabilities, flexible reasoning effort modes, and native OpenAI Responses API support. Alongside the new model, the company introduced peak/off-peak API pricing with off-peak rates set at 50% lower than peak, effective from 16:00 UTC on August 16, 2026.
